parameters.name: num_workers
parameters.description: Number of workers in the worker set

parameters.name: num_tasks
parameters.description: Number of tasks in the task set

parameters.name: processing_hours
parameters.description: Processing-time matrix where p_{ij} is the working hours required for worker i to complete task j

variables.name: assignment_matrix
variables.description: Binary assignment matrix where x_{ij}=1 if worker i is assigned to task j, and 0 otherwise

variables.name: unassigned_worker_index
variables.description: Index of the worker left unassigned

variables.name: total_working_hours
variables.description: Total working-hours value of the chosen assignment

constraints.name: binary_assignment_domain
constraints.description: Assignment matrix entries are binary decision variables

constraints.name: unassigned_worker_index_domain
constraints.description: The unassigned worker index must be an integer worker index within the valid worker range

constraints.name: positive_integer_sizes
constraints.description: The number of workers and the number of tasks are positive integers

constraints.name: single_stage_horizon_integer
constraints.description: The planning horizon is an integer planning-stage parameter

constraints.name: processing_hours_nonnegative
constraints.description: Processing-hour values are nonnegative real numbers or integers as provided

constraints.name: task_coverage_exactly_one
constraints.description: Every task must be covered by exactly one worker.

constraints.name: worker_capacity_at_most_one
constraints.description: Each worker may be assigned to at most one task.

constraints.name: exactly_one_unassigned_worker
constraints.description: Exactly one worker remains unassigned in the final plan, consistent with the cardinality balance M=N+1.

constraints.name: total_working_hours_nonnegative
constraints.description: The total working-hours value is nonnegative

constraints.name: total_working_hours_definition
constraints.description: Defines total working hours as the sum of processing hours over all assigned worker-task pairs.

constraints.name: planning_horizon_feasibility
constraints.description: Each assigned worker-task pair must fit within the single-stage planning horizon, expressed linearly using the binary assignment variable.

constraints.name: idle_worker_selection_link
constraints.description: Link the reported idle-worker index to the unique unassigned worker via aggregate selection variables so the output index k is consistent with the assignment matrix X.

objectives.name: total_working_hours_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total working-hours value of the assignment while covering all tasks with a feasible worker-to-task assignment

final_objective.description: Minimize the total working hours of the assignment. This remains a single-objective MILP and is defined through the auxiliary total-hours variable Z linked linearly to the assignment matrix X.
